cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: the paved square before a city gate tower — standing; a grand museum hall with marble statues at night — holds a freshly printed instant photo up to the light; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; a quiet city tram-stop platform at dawn — she is delightedly taking a first bite from a very large steamed breakfast bun before the tram arrives; a small outdoor carnival rehearsal yard with striped fabric pavilions — she is trying the padded seat of a miniature fairground ride; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — kneeling on the ground; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — tears a finished page out of a notebook; a starship galley and mess hall — trims the stems of a few loose flower stems on the worktable; her living room with a deep sofa — standing; a sunlit white marble temple — holds her keepsake at chest height; a rooftop infinity pool with the city skyline behind it — lying on her front
